hints.title: Key Value Reversal Mapping
hints.text: Invert an associative collection by converting values into property names and collecting colliding keys into arrays.

hints.title: Collision Detection and Promotion
hints.text: Iterate over all keys. If the target property already exists, promote a single string to an array or append to the existing list.

hints.title: Inversion Blueprint
hints.text: For each key in obj, let val = obj[key]. If val is in res, convert to array or push key. Otherwise res[val] = key.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of properties or elements in obj
complexity.notes: Iterates through entries once with constant-time lookup and promotion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct key assignment overwrites previous occurrences when multiple properties share identical values.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocates storage for inverted dictionary and collision arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty and Array.isArray for reliable property checking.

solutions.approach: Property Inversion with Dynamic Collision Promotion
